subject.title: Image tool fails to resolve media:// protocol paths for inbound Discord media

question: Should maintainers require a live Discord current-main reproduction before promoting a repair for this `media://inbound` resolver miss?
rationale: Source proves the generic resolver and the exact error path, but not which Discord-specific state, ID, queue, or cleanup path is still failing after the generic media URI fix.

options.title: Require live Discord proof
options.body: Keep the issue open and require a live Discord DM attachment run or targeted runtime logs before choosing a repair boundary.

options.title: Promote a diagnostic-only repair
options.body: Allow a narrow PR that adds logging or regression scaffolding without changing resolver behavior until the mismatch is proven.

options.title: Treat as covered by generic resolver
options.body: Close only if maintainers can provide external proof that v2026.6.11/current main fixes this exact Discord failure mode.

recommendation.title: Require live Discord proof
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and require a live Discord DM attachment run or targeted runtime logs before choosing a repair boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest history on the central media-reference and image-tool resolver surface that would decide whether more proof is needed before repair.
